process_area.title: Apprenticeship Program Design, TESDA Registration & Governance

value_stream.name: Skilled-Trade Apprenticeship, Vocational Education & Capability Pipeline

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, L&D (links to VS-19.4), Store Ops (links to VS-07), In-Store Services (links to VS-09), Installation (links to VS-12), HR (links to VS-19/VS-103), Workforce Planning (links to VS-103.3), Strategy (links to VS-33)
fields.Trigger: Annual people strategy (links to VS-33.1/VS-103.3); capability gap

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-post of "posture and build-vs-buy approach" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-register of "Trade Capability/L&D charter the apprenticeship program as the primary" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approve the program budget" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-598 (ensure controlled execution — Apprenticeship Program Design, TESDA Registration & Governance (PA-123.1).)
- operational: capability strategy; operational: formal charter
Pain Points / Risks: - **Capability-gap risk**: Trade knowledge gaps unaddressed, hurting service quality; mitigated by capability strategy
- **Ad-hoc risk**: Apprenticeship run informally without charter/governance; mitigated by formal charter
System Touchpoints: - L&D (links to VS-19.4); workforce planning (links to VS-103.3); store ops (links to VS-07); in-store services (links to VS-09); installation (links to VS-12); strategy (links to VS-33); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/L&D/Store-Ops define the trade-capability strategy: identify the critical trade roles and skills BuildRight must master (lumber/yard, tiles/flooring, plumbing, electrical, paint/tinting, hand/power tools, hardware/fasteners; plus fabrication/estimation/installation), assess current capability gaps, and set the target capability posture and build-vs-buy approach

Trade Capability/L&D charter the apprenticeship program as the primary capability-build vehicle: program objectives (certified trade capability, succession for trade-master roles, scalable service quality), target cohorts/scale, the TESDA-registered model (links to W3811), and the link to workforce planning (links to VS-103.3) and store growth (links to VS-37)

CHRO/Executive ratify the trade-capability strategy and apprenticeship charter, approve the program budget (links to W3812), and cascade to category/store leadership as a BuildRight capability priority

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, L&D (links to VS-19.4), Master Tradespersons (links to VS-07/VS-09), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Quality (links to VS-31), Compliance (links to VS-22), Vendor/Product experts

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-match of "paint tinting/colour matching, power-tool operation/safety" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate the curriculum against TESDA standards and BuildRight policy, and…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-598 (ensure controlled execution — Apprenticeship Program Design, TESDA Registration & Governance (PA-123.1).)
- operational: master-tradesperson input; operational: TR mapping (links to W3811)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Curriculum-irrelevance risk**: Curriculum out of step with store/service reality; mitigated by master-tradesperson input
- **Standard-misalignment risk**: Curriculum not TESDA-aligned, blocking certification; mitigated by TR mapping (links to W3811)
System Touchpoints: - L&D/competency (links to VS-19.4/W683); in-store services (links to VS-09); product info (links to VS-01.3); HSE (links to VS-24); quality (links to VS-31)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/L&D design the apprenticeship curriculum and competency standard per trade: theory modules, practical competencies (e.g., lumber grading/board-foot, tile laying/grout, pipe fitting, basic electrical safety, paint tinting/colour matching, power-tool operation/safety), mapped to TESDA Training Regulations/NC levels (links to W3811) and to BuildRight's competency framework (links to VS-19.4/W683)

Trade Capability/Master-Tradespersons build the practical/on-the-job training design: store/DC rotation, fabrication-bay and estimation practice (links to VS-09.1/VS-09.2), shadowing, and competency sign-off standards, ensuring safety (links to VS-24) and product/brand knowledge (vendor content links to VS-01.3)
steps.r: Trade Capability / Store Ops / Master Tradespersons

steps.activity: Trade Capability/Compliance validate the curriculum against TESDA standards and BuildRight policy, and define the assessment/certification criteria (links to W3819/W3811)

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, Compliance (links to VS-22), L&D (links to VS-19.4), Legal (links to VS-100.3), HR (links to VS-19/VS-103), Records (links to VS-88), TESDA

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documentation, competency standards" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "center accreditation where applicable, and reporting to TESDA" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Records/Legal manage the dual-training agreements" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Non-registration risk**: Program run without TESDA registration → invalid certifications/penalty; mitigated by registration
- **Compliance-lapse risk**: Standards/instructor qualification drift; mitigated by audit/readiness
System Touchpoints: - Compliance (links to VS-22); legal (links to VS-100.3); records (links to VS-88); L&D (links to VS-19.4); HR (links to VS-19)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/Compliance register BuildRight's apprenticeship/dual-training program with TESDA per RA 7796 and the dual-training-system (DTS) rules: program documentation, competency standards (links to W3810), facility/instructor qualification, and TESDA approval/registration

Trade Capability/Compliance manage ongoing TESDA compliance: program audit/readiness, instructor/assessor qualification (links to W3828), assessment-center accreditation where applicable, and reporting to TESDA

Trade Capability/Records/Legal manage the dual-training agreements (BuildRight–apprentice–school for DTS), compliance documentation, and records retention (links to VS-88), and support TESDA inspection (links to VS-22.2)

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, Finance (links to VS-17.4), HR (links to VS-19/VS-102), Compensation (links to VS-102), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Compliance (links to VS-22), DOLE

workflows.name: Apprenticeship Funding, Stipend & DOLE Labor Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "track program cost vs budget and ROI" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: lawful agreement terms; operational: cost tracking and ROI
Pain Points / Risks: - **Misclassification risk**: Apprentices used as cheap labor in violation of rules; mitigated by lawful agreement terms
- **Cost-overrun risk**: Program cost exceeds budget/ROI; mitigated by cost tracking and ROI
System Touchpoints: - Finance (links to VS-17.4); compensation (links to VS-102); payroll (links to VS-19.2); legal (links to VS-100.3); labor compliance (links to VS-84); HSE (links to VS-24); contingent workforce (links to VS-98)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/Finance/HR design the apprenticeship funding model: apprentice stipend/allowance (within DOLE apprenticeship/dual-training rules), training cost, tool/PPE/kit cost (links to W172), certification fees, and instructor cost; align to budget (links to VS-33.1/VS-17.4)

Trade Capability/HR/Legal ensure DOLE labor compliance for the apprenticeship: apprenticeship/dual-training agreement terms, stipend/allowance lawfulness, working-hours/safety (links to VS-24/VS-84), and conversion-to-regular-employment rules; avoid misclassification (links to VS-98 contingent-workforce risk)
Trade Capability/Finance track program cost vs budget and ROI (cost per certified apprentice, conversion/retention, productivity uplift — links to W3832), and report to CHRO and Finance

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, Compliance (links to VS-22), Legal (links to VS-100.3), HR (links to VS-19), Audit (links to VS-21), Store Ops (links to VS-07), CHRO

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-post of "posture to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: steering committee; operational: policy and oversight
Pain Points / Risks: - **Governance-gap risk**: Program run without oversight → standards drift; mitigated by steering committee
- **Selection-favoritism risk**: Apprentice selection biased; mitigated by policy and oversight
System Touchpoints: - Compliance (links to VS-22); legal (links to VS-100.3); audit (links to VS-21); HR (links to VS-19); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/Compliance maintain the apprenticeship policy and authority: program scope and standards, apprentice selection/progression authority, certification authority, budget/stipend authority (links to W3812), and the ethics/anti-fraud controls on selection and assessment

Trade Capability establish the program governance: steering committee (Trade Capability, L&D, Store Ops, HR, Finance), cadence, KPIs (links to W3832), and escalation; integrate to HR governance (links to VS-36/VS-103)
Trade Capability/Audit support apprenticeship audit (internal links to VS-21, TESDA/DOLE links to VS-22), manage findings, and report compliance posture to governance (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, TA Marketing (links to VS-121), Recruiting (links to VS-19.1), HR (links to VS-19), L&D (links to VS-19.4), DEI (links to VS-103.2), Store Ops (links to VS-07)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-assign of "assignment to cohort/store/mentor" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-598 (ensure controlled execution — Apprenticeship Program Design, TESDA Registration & Governance (PA-123.1).)
- operational: employer-brand and school pipeline (links to W3826); operational: inclusive outreach
Pain Points / Risks: - **Recruitment-shortfall risk**: Insufficient qualified apprentices; mitigated by employer-brand and school pipeline (links to W3826)
- **Equity risk**: Apprentice selection non-inclusive; mitigated by inclusive outreach
System Touchpoints: - TA/employer brand (links to VS-121); recruiting (links to VS-19.1); HR/onboarding (links to VS-19.1/W15); PPE (links to W172); HSE (links to VS-24); DEI (links to VS-103.2)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/TA-Marketing market and recruit apprentices: employer-brand campaign for apprenticeship (links to VS-121 W3761/W3763), sourcing from vocational schools/TESDA partners (links to W3826) and the community, and inclusive outreach (women in trades, regional — links to VS-103.2)

Trade Capability/Recruiting select apprentices: aptitude/interest assessment, basic trade awareness, structured interview (links to VS-121 W3772), eligibility/DOLE compliance (links to W3812), and offer/enrollment into the cohort

Trade Capability/HR onboard the apprentice cohort: agreement (DTS/apprenticeship — links to W3811), induction, PPE/kit issuance (links to W172), safety orientation (links to VS-24), and assignment to cohort/store/mentor (links to W3820/W3821)

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, Records (links to VS-88), L&D (links to VS-19.4), HR (links to VS-19/VS-103.3), Compliance (links to VS-22), Data Privacy (links to VS-91)
fields.Trigger: Cohort progression (links to W3821); certification event

workflows.name: Apprenticeship Records, Certification Issuance & Compliance Documentation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Trade Capability/L&D maintain the apprentice record and progress log" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Trade Capability/Compliance manage certification issuance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documentation per VS-88 and TESDA/DOLE rules, and support inspection/audit" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: records discipline; operational: RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Records-gap risk**: Missing progress/certification records fail audit; mitigated by records discipline
- **Privacy risk**: Apprentice data mishandled; mitigated by RA 10173 governance (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - L&D/HRIS (links to VS-103.3/VS-19.4); records (links to VS-88); compliance (links to VS-22); data privacy (links to VS-91)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/L&D maintain the apprentice record and progress log: enrollment, modules completed, practical competencies signed off (links to W3819), attendance, assessments, and mentor evaluations, in the L&D/HRIS system (links to VS-103.3/VS-19.4)

Trade Capability/Compliance manage certification issuance: TESDA NC/COC assessment coordination (links to W3811/W3819), BuildRight internal trade certification, and certification records; ensure lawful data handling (links to VS-91)
Trade Capability/Records manage apprenticeship records retention and compliance documentation per VS-88 and TESDA/DOLE rules, and support inspection/audit (links to W3813)

fields.Participants: Trade Capability, L&D (links to VS-19.4), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Master Tradespersons (links to W3828), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Quality (links to VS-31), Analytics (links to VS-28.1)
fields.Trigger: Annual review; outcome analytics (links to W3832); product/category change

workflows.name: Apprenticeship Program Continuous Improvement & Curriculum Refresh

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review program outcomes" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-update of "update TESDA registration where standards change" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track the impact in the next outcome cycle" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-598 (ensure controlled execution — Apprenticeship Program Design, TESDA Registration & Governance (PA-123.1).)
- operational: annual refresh; operational: outcome analytics
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stale-curriculum risk**: Curriculum not updated for new products/methods; mitigated by annual refresh
- **No-feedback-loop risk**: Improvements not data-driven; mitigated by outcome analytics
System Touchpoints: - L&D (links to VS-19.4); merchandising/assortment (links to VS-01); in-store services (links to VS-09); analytics (links to VS-28.1); quality (links to VS-31)

steps.activity: Trade Capability/L&D review program outcomes (completion, certification, placement, retention, service-quality uplift — links to W3832), gather apprentice/mentor/store feedback, and identify improvement themes

Trade Capability/Master-Tradespersons refresh curriculum and standards for new products/categories/methods (links to VS-01.1 assortment, VS-09 services), and update TESDA registration where standards change (links to W3811)
Trade Capability implement improvements, communicate to instructors/mentors/stores (links to W3828/W3821), and track the impact in the next outcome cycle (links to W3832)
